g.text: Redis CPU gap is set by --threads (whether the client can outrun the server), not by pinning, -d or -n

text.style: fill: #52514e; font: 9px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: With --threads 2 the gap is 1.2-1.8 us per request, without it 0.9-1.0 us, pinned or not; the cause is the cost of cross-CPU wake-ups (IPIs) in this VM.
